title: Ericsson explores the future of intelligent networks with industry analysts
summary: At its annual industry analyst event in Boston, Ericsson brought together more than 65 industry analysts, customers and partners at the Boston Public Library to explore how intelligent networks are creating new opportunities across healthcare, enterprise, public safety and financial services.
